answer: Staking pools isolate untrusted traffic in a settlement lagoon before routing into the main transaction river. If an identity submits conflicting state commitments, validators push its deposit off the solvency ledge: 100% of the 30,000 POA bond is slashed (50% burned, 50% paid to the reporter) plus an 8-epoch ban. Running 1,000 sybil nodes requires locking 30,000,000 POA upfront compared to a single 30,000 POA bond for an honest agent. A drawback is significant capital centralization favoring wealthy node clusters.
